justification: Inspected ui/src/main/java/org/adoptopenjdk/jitwatch/ui/resize/IRedrawable.java and RateLimitedResizeListener.java: the package contains only two types, and RateLimitedResizeListener depends outward only on javafx.application.Platform and javafx.beans.value.* plus the local IRedrawable. Cross-references show three incoming users from ui.compilechain.CompileChainStage, ui.graphing.AbstractGraphStage, and ui.nmethod.AbstractNMethodStage, all of which import both resize types and instantiate RateLimitedResizeListener. With more incoming package references than external outgoing dependencies, the package does not look unstable.
